n: The European Union row is the source's own entity, whose membership changes: European Union with the UK, 2005/06 to 2015/16, until USDA PSD lists the United Kingdom as a row of its own; European Union, from 2016/17. The atlas does not add or remove members: the trend line breaks where the row changes.
Serbia has figures of its own from 2006/07: up to 2005/06 the source gives Serbia and Montenegro as one entity, which is not a country row of the table.
